verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a data/CDP infrastructure pipeline (collection, transformation, warehouse delivery, profiles) with an MCP server for agent-driven pipeline configuration, but there is no evidence of an autonomous decisioning agent that selects messages, timing, or channels per customer, nor any measurable-lift/experimentation framework. Missing for 10: autonomous message/channel/timing selection engine, guardrail configuration for such decisions, and lift measurement/reporting.
